[Rotector website](https://rotector.com) · [Discord](https://discord.gg/2Cn7kXqqhY)

tags.name: Rotector terms of use
tags.description:
By calling the Rotector source you agree to the following terms and to our [full terms of service](https://rayward.app/terms). Violation may result in revocation of API access without notice.

1. API responses must not be stored for longer than **24 hours**. Flag statuses can change at any time, and stale data leads to incorrect enforcement.
2. Any action taken on this data must name Rotector as the source, or give their appeal route returned by `/v2/providers` where your platform permits off-site links. Rayward cannot overturn a Rotector decision.
3. Anything you show from this source must be labelled as coming from the Rotector database.
4. Users with a flag type of `Unflagged` must not be presented as "Safe" in your application. It only means no violations have been detected yet, regardless of whether the account is queued for review.
5. Data from this source may not be resold, republished, or redistributed to third parties without permission.
6. Systematic scraping, bulk downloading, and working around rate limits are prohibited.
7. This source may not be used for harassment, intimidation, doxxing, fraud, or any other unlawful or malicious purpose, nor for anything against Discord's Terms of Service.
8. Flags carry no guarantee of accuracy and you are responsible for any action you take on them. They should be reviewed by a human before you act on them.

tags.name: Reference
tags.description:
## Authentication

Lookups require an API key. Create one at [rayward.app](https://rayward.app/signin).

Include your key in the `Authorization` header, with or without the Bearer prefix:

```
Authorization: Bearer rwd_your_key_here
```

## Limits

Limits apply per account, so all of your keys and any extension session share the same allowance.

**Requests per 10 seconds.** Every account starts at 100 requests per 10 seconds, and the limit increases over time up to an undisclosed maximum. Each source has its own counter, and a batch counts as one unit per 10 ids. Every response includes your current limit in the `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` headers, and a 429 response includes `Retry-After`.

**Subjects per day.** The number of accounts you look up is counted per UTC day, and this daily limit also increases over time. When it is reached, requests return 429 with the code `DAILY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED` and a `Retry-After` header set to midnight UTC.

**Suspension.** Accounts that scrape the dataset are suspended, and a suspended account gets 403 on every request, with the code `ACCESS_NOT_APPROVED` and `details.status` set to `suspended`, and the notice is on your account page. Access is restored by a reviewer and does not come back on its own.

Queue submission is not available to API keys.

## Errors

A failure returns the same envelope with `success: false`.

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Unknown or disabled source 'nope'",
  "requestId": "f3b874e6-15ba-49e7-8a90-e84aefa91576",
  "type": "NotFoundError",
  "code": "NOT_FOUND"
}
```

`error` is a plain message and `requestId` identifies this call, so quote it when reporting a problem. Branch on `code`. Validation failures carry no `code`, so treat a 400 without one as a bad request.

| Status | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| 400 | The request was malformed, or the source does not support what you asked it for |
| 401 | No valid API key was supplied |
| 403 | Your access is not approved or has been suspended, and `details.status` says which |
| 404 | The source is unknown or currently disabled |
| 429 | Rate limit or daily subject quota reached, and `Retry-After` says when to come back |
| 503 | The source's own systems did not answer |

**A 503 does not mean the account is clean.** The source did not answer, so you learned nothing about it. Do not cache the result, do not show the account as unflagged, and retry later or ask another source.

## Languages

`lang` accepts `ar`, `bn`, `de`, `en`, `es`, `fil`, `fr`, `hi`, `id`, `it`, `ja`, `ko`, `ms`, `nl`, `pl`, `pt`, `ru`, `sv`, `th`, `tr`, `uk`, `vi`, `zh-CN` and `zh-TW`. Anything else falls back to English.

It changes `title`, `headerMessage`, `statusLabel` and `categoryLabel` only. `type`, `category` and every id stay the same in all languages.

## Reading a flag

Every lookup returns `flagType`. Sources that explain their finding also return `reasons`.

`reasons` is sorted strongest first, and so is `sources` inside each reason. No confidence score is returned, so the order is the only ranking you get. Do not re-sort.

| Field | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `type` | An identifier such as `condo` or `profile`. It is the same in every language, so branch your code on this field. |
| `title` | The same reason in words, translated for `lang`. Show it to users, but never compare against it, because the text changes per language. |
| `sources` | The detectors that contributed to this reason, such as `trap` or `discord`. The `sources` array on `/v2/providers` names each id and explains most of them. |
| `evidence` | What the source found. Absent when it recorded none. |

### Reason types by source

Each source names its own reasons, and there is no shared vocabulary, so check `type` against the source you called.

| Source | `type` values |
|--------|----------------|
| Rotector | `condo`, `profile`, `outfit`, `chat`, `creations`, `badges`, `favorites`, `groups`, `friends`, `other` for Roblox users, `purpose`, `description`, `shout`, `member` for groups, and `discord_membership` for Discord accounts |
| TASE | `discord_membership` |
| ServerSweep | `discord_membership` |
| Okappiki | `condo_discord_servers` |
| RAB | Whatever RAB itself returns, so the set is not fixed and `title` repeats `type` in English |
| RCR | Each charge RCR filed, such as `Online Harassment`, so the set is not fixed and `title` repeats `type` in English |


## Evidence

A reason can name several detectors in `sources`, but it carries one `evidence` list covering the whole reason. Which detector found which item is not recorded, so do not attribute an evidence item to a particular detector.

Evidence is supporting detail, not the finding. Act on `flagType` and the reason. Never weaken a flag because you could not display its evidence.

Each item has a `kind`. New kinds are added without a version bump, so an unfamiliar one must not break parsing. Render the kinds you support and pass over the rest.

| `kind` | Carries | Emitted by |
|--------|---------|------------|
| `text` | A line describing what the source found | Rotector, Okappiki, RAB, RCR |
| `outfit` | Outfit name, category, description | Rotector |
| `discordUser` | The id of a Discord account linked to this user | Rotector |
| `discordGuild` | A tracked server, and what the member did in it | Rotector, TASE, ServerSweep |

Every `discordGuild` item carries `safeName`, `discordId`, `types`, and the nullable fields `name`, `joinedAt`, `firstSeen` and `lastSeen`. Optional fields such as `serverId`, message counts and the `staff` and `booster` flags appear only when the source records them.

`safeName` is the safe/static display label. `name` returns the actual server name on record, or `null` when unavailable. It may contain unsafe content: clients should display `safeName`, not `name`. The Roblox-to-Discord membership response uses the same `safeName` and `name` fields.

`joinedAt` is the actual server join date in Unix seconds, or `null` when unknown. It is separate from `firstSeen` (first observation) and `lastSeen` (last recorded activity or membership update). Rotector and ServerSweep supply join dates; TASE supplies observation dates only, so its `joinedAt` is `null`. For compatibility, ServerSweep also continues to return its join date in `firstSeen`. Do not infer a join date from an observation date.

### Example

```json
{
  "id": 1234567,
  "flagType": 2,
  "statusLabel": "Unsafe",
  "reasons": [
    {
      "type": "condo",
      "title": "Condo Activity",
      "sources": [
        { "id": "trap", "label": "Trap", "summary": "Joined a monitored condo game" },
        { "id": "discord", "label": "Discord" }
      ],
      "evidence": [
        { "kind": "discordUser", "discordId": "100000000000000001" },
        { "kind": "text", "text": "Member of 3 confirmed condo groups." }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "profile",
      "title": "User Profile",
      "sources": [{ "id": "rotector", "label": "Rotector" }],
      "evidence": [{ "kind": "text", "text": "Coded solicitation in the description." }]
    }
  ]
}
```

## Details worth knowing

- Discord lookups return `id` as a string, since snowflakes exceed the JavaScript safe integer range. Roblox lookups return an integer.
- `excludeInfo=true` removes evidence and detector summaries. Types, titles and detector ids stay.
- Batch responses are keyed by the id you sent and include every id, unflagged ones included.
- `headerMessage` and `statusLabel` are translated for `lang`, falling back to English.
- No finding means `flagType` 0 and no `reasons` field, not an empty array.


## Flag Types

`flagType` values `Rotector` can return. Other sources return a different set.

| Value | Name | Safe to action | Description |
|-------|------|----------------|-------------|
| 0 | Unflagged | No | No violations detected **yet**. |
| 1 | Flagged | Yes | System-detected violations with high accuracy. |
| 2 | Confirmed | Yes | A violation this source has confirmed. How confirmation is reached varies by source, from human review to automated detection. |
| 3 | Queued | No | Submitted for review. Not a finding. |
| 4 | Provisional Flag | No | Flagged, but the reasons are withheld pending human review. |
| 5 | Mixed | No | Some inappropriate activity, but insufficient evidence to act on. |
| 6 | Past Offender | No | Previously flagged, since cleared. |
| 8 | Redacted | No | Reasons and evidence withheld under a privacy restriction. |
| 10 | Awaiting Human Review | No | Automated analysis did not finish, so a human review is pending. |

> **Warning:** do not treat every non-zero value as a hit. From this source only Flagged and Confirmed mean the account did something. The rest are process states.

tags.name: Rotector data
tags.description:
Categories and reason types specific to Rotector. Other sources return their own reason types and no category.

## Content Categories

`category` is a stable slug naming what kind of content the violations fall under, with the translated `categoryLabel` beside it. Neither is returned for every user, and both are omitted when `excludeInfo` is set.

| `category` | Label | Description |
|------------|-------|-------------|
| `csam` | CSAM | Content involving the sexual exploitation of minors |
| `sexual` | Sexual | Sexual or pornographic content |
| `kink` | Kink | BDSM, fetish, and kink-related content |
| `raceplay` | Raceplay | Race-based roleplay or racially charged sexual content |
| `condo` | Condo | Activity in Roblox "condo" games designed for sexual roleplay |
| `other` | Other | Inappropriate content that does not fit the categories above |

## Reason Types

Values of `reasons[].type`, in the order Rotector returns them.

| `type` | Title | Description |
|--------|-------|-------------|
| `condo` | Condo Activity | Participation in known inappropriate games (condos) |
| `profile` | User Profile | Inappropriate display name, description, or social links |
| `outfit` | Avatar Outfit | Inappropriate or rule-violating avatar outfits |
| `chat` | Chat Messages | Inappropriate content detected in chat messages |
| `creations` | User Creations | Inappropriate user-created games or assets |
| `badges` | Earned Badges | Badges earned from inappropriate games |
| `favorites` | Game Favorites | Favouriting games associated with inappropriate content |
| `groups` | Group Membership | Membership in groups associated with inappropriate activity |
| `friends` | Friend Network | Connections to known flagged users |
| `other` | Other Reasons | Violations that fit none of the above |

### Group Reason Types

| `type` | Title | Description |
|--------|-------|-------------|
| `purpose` | Group Purpose | The group's stated purpose indicates inappropriate activity |
| `description` | Group Description | Inappropriate content in the group's description |
| `shout` | Group Shout | Inappropriate content in the group's shout |
| `member` | Member Analysis | The group holds a significant number of flagged members |

## Connection Sources

A different field to `reasons[].sources`. On `/roblox/user/{id}/discord`, each linked Discord and alt account carries a numeric `sources` array recording how the link was detected.

| Value | Name |
|-------|------|
| 2 | Discord Profile |
| 3 | Rayward |

Values 0 and 1 are withheld. Records predating source tracking carry an empty array.

Which caller to answer for. Defaults to the caller's own: 'api' when authenticated with a key, 'extension' otherwise.

appealUrl.description: Where a flagged user appeals this source's findings: an https link, a mailto, or empty when the source takes no appeals

accentColor.description: Hex brand color, or null for a neutral accent

severity.description: Relative seriousness, higher wins. An ordering, not a score

tone.description: Visual treatment: safe, pending, mixed or unsafe

isFlagged.description: Whether this verdict is an open finding

flagTypes.description: Flag types this source can return, lowest value first

description.description: Localized explanation of how it detects

sources.description: Detectors this source's reasons can name, matching Reason.sources[].id

get.description: Returns the enabled safety sources with their capabilities, accent color, and theme-aware asset URLs. Sources withdrawn from the requested audience are omitted.
